purpose: P5-Z offline diagnostic selector; not production gating

recipe.loss: CE(D3 argmin, tie MOVE) + 0.25 * expected_D3 / max(train mean D_zero,1e-3)
recipe.schedule: linear warmup then cosine to zero
recipe.decision: ZERO iff logit_zero > logit_move; ties MOVE (p_move>=0.5)

train.policy: stored GPU candidate_costs authoritative; CPU recomputation is audit only

tune.policy: stored GPU candidate_costs authoritative; CPU recomputation is audit only

initial_all_move_proof.method: final W exactly zero and bias exactly [-2,+2], independent of every feature row

train.selection_rule: ZERO iff logit_zero > logit_move; exact tie MOVE

tune.selection_rule: ZERO iff logit_zero > logit_move; exact tie MOVE

selector_minus_original_p4_session_clust.method: 세션 uniform 복원추출; 선택된 모든 프레임의 오차 합/프레임 수. frame IID 아님
selector_minus_original_p4_session_clust.interpretation: exploratory repeatedly-used tune; not a final-holdout or compliance test
